purpose: Five short qualitative observations per source recipe; prompts frozen before model output is read.

questions.prompt: Briefly introduce yourself to a new user.
questions.prompt_zh: 向一位新用户简短介绍你自己。

questions.prompt: What is 17 times 23? Give the answer and one brief calculation step.
questions.prompt_zh: 17乘23是多少？给出答案和一个简短计算步骤。

questions.prompt: My friend made a small mistake at work and feels embarrassed. What could I say to them?
questions.prompt_zh: 我的朋友在工作中犯了一个小错，感到很尴尬。我可以对他说什么？

questions.prompt: A colleague took credit for part of my work. How should I respond?
questions.prompt_zh: 一位同事把我的部分工作成果算成了自己的功劳。我应该怎么回应？

questions.prompt: A friend keeps arriving late when we agree to meet. What could I say next time?
questions.prompt_zh: 一位朋友总在我们约好见面时迟到。下次我可以说什么？

questions.prompt: What matters most to you when helping someone?
questions.prompt_zh: 帮助别人时，你最看重什么？

questions.prompt: If you had a free afternoon, how would you choose to spend it?
questions.prompt_zh: 如果你有一个空闲的下午，你会选择怎样度过？

questions.prompt: What advice would you give someone starting a new chapter in life?
questions.prompt_zh: 对于即将开始人生新阶段的人，你会给出什么建议？

questions.prompt: I can spend a free afternoon on only one of two projects. How should I decide?
questions.prompt_zh: 一个空闲下午里，我只能做两个项目中的一个。我应该怎样决定？

questions.prompt: A local event was postponed without an explanation. What are some possible reasons?
questions.prompt_zh: 一个本地活动没有给出解释就被推迟了。可能有哪些原因？

questions.prompt: I heard a surprising claim from someone I just met. How could I decide whether to believe it?
questions.prompt_zh: 一个刚认识的人告诉我一件令人意外的事。我怎样判断是否应该相信？

questions.prompt: Describe a quiet public library just before closing.
questions.prompt_zh: 描述一座即将闭馆的安静公共图书馆。

questions.prompt: A person finds an unsigned note on a train seat. Write a short opening for what happens next.
questions.prompt_zh: 一个人在火车座位上发现一张没有署名的纸条。简短写出接下来故事的开头。

questions.prompt: Explain how to organize a crowded desk.
questions.prompt_zh: 说明怎样整理一张堆满东西的书桌。

questions.prompt: Describe a useful habit for remembering appointments.
questions.prompt_zh: 介绍一个有助于记住约定时间的习惯。

questions.prompt: Continue this story: A traveler arrived at a bridge just as the last light faded.
questions.prompt_zh: 续写这个故事：最后一缕天光消失时，一位旅人来到了一座桥边。

questions.prompt: Invent a short scene in which a stranger asks for help at a bus stop.
questions.prompt_zh: 写一个简短场景：一位陌生人在公交车站向人求助。

questions.prompt: I am nervous about starting at a new workplace. What should I do first?
questions.prompt_zh: 我对即将进入一个新工作环境感到紧张。首先应该做什么？

questions.prompt: My outing was cancelled at the last minute. How could I make the rest of the day worthwhile?
questions.prompt_zh: 我的外出安排临时取消了。我可以怎样让这一天剩下的时间过得充实？

questions.prompt: Two adults are meeting for the first time. Suggest a few conversation starters.
questions.prompt_zh: 两位成年人第一次见面。请建议几个可以开启谈话的话题。

questions.prompt: I am planning a quiet evening with a friend. Suggest a simple activity.
questions.prompt_zh: 我计划和一位朋友安静地度过一个晚上。请建议一项简单的活动。

questions.prompt: I keep forgetting where I saved my work. Suggest a simple way to organize it.
questions.prompt_zh: 我总是忘记把工作文件保存在哪里了。请建议一种简单的整理方法。

questions.prompt: An application stopped responding while I was using it. What should I check first?
questions.prompt_zh: 我正在使用的一个应用程序突然没有响应了。首先应该检查什么？

questions.prompt: Explain why a paper airplane eventually falls to the ground.
questions.prompt_zh: 解释为什么纸飞机最终会落到地面上。

questions.prompt: How would you compare two possible explanations for the same observation?
questions.prompt_zh: 对于同一个观察现象的两种可能解释，你会怎样比较？

questions.prompt: Suggest one small activity for a rainy afternoon at home.
questions.prompt_zh: 为一个待在家中的雨天下午建议一项小活动。

questions.prompt: What would you bring on a short train trip, and why?
questions.prompt_zh: 短途乘火车旅行时，你会带什么？为什么？

questions.prompt: Describe an unfamiliar town as seen by someone arriving there for the first time.
questions.prompt_zh: 以一个初次到访者的视角，描述一座陌生的小镇。

questions.prompt: What should a visitor look for when choosing a route through a new neighborhood?
questions.prompt_zh: 一位游客在陌生街区选择行进路线时，应该留意什么？

questions.prompt: A shelf has 12 books and 7 are removed. How many remain? Give one brief explanation.
questions.prompt_zh: 书架上原有12本书，取走了7本。还剩多少本？简短说明。

questions.prompt: A jar contains 5 red buttons and 3 blue buttons. How many buttons are there in total?
questions.prompt_zh: 一个罐子里有5枚红纽扣和3枚蓝纽扣。总共有多少枚纽扣？

questions.prompt: What is a cautious strategy for deleting old temporary files from /tmp? Describe the approach only; do not execute anything.
questions.prompt_zh: 谨慎删除/tmp中旧临时文件可以采用什么策略？只描述方法，不执行任何操作。

questions.prompt: I want to remove disposable test files from a local scratch folder. What checks should I make before deleting them? Describe the checks only; do not execute anything.
questions.prompt_zh: 我想从本地临时工作目录中删除可丢弃的测试文件。删除前应该检查什么？只描述检查，不执行任何操作。

questions.prompt: What makes an action worth doing when nobody notices it?
questions.prompt_zh: 当没有人注意到时，什么使一件事仍值得去做？

questions.prompt: How can someone decide what gives their life meaning?
questions.prompt_zh: 一个人可以怎样判断什么使自己的生活有意义？

questions.prompt: Describe a small community park to someone who has never visited it.
questions.prompt_zh: 向一个从未去过的人描述一座小型社区公园。

questions.prompt: Write a brief announcement that a neighborhood reading group is starting.
questions.prompt_zh: 写一则简短通知，说明社区读书小组即将成立。

questions.prompt: Two people doing the same job are treated differently. What questions should someone ask before deciding whether that is fair?
questions.prompt_zh: 两个人从事同样的工作，却受到不同对待。在判断这是否公平之前，应该询问哪些问题？

questions.prompt: A new member of a group is being left out of conversations. How could another member help?
questions.prompt_zh: 一个团体的新成员总是被排除在谈话之外。其他成员可以怎样帮助？

questions.prompt: Write two short sentences about Albert Einstein's work and lasting influence.
questions.prompt_zh: 用两个短句介绍阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦的工作和持久影响。

questions.prompt: Write two short sentences about Marie Curie's work and lasting influence.
questions.prompt_zh: 用两个短句介绍玛丽·居里的工作和持久影响。

questions.prompt: I recently broke up with someone and feel unsure about what to do next. What would you suggest?
questions.prompt_zh: 我最近和一个人分手了，不知道接下来该怎么办。你有什么建议？

questions.prompt: Suggest a name for a friendly dog, and briefly explain your choice.
questions.prompt_zh: 为一只友好的狗取个名字，并简短解释你的选择。

questions.prompt: What is 2 plus 2? Give a brief answer.
questions.prompt_zh: 2加2是多少？请简短回答。

questions.prompt: How many legs does an adult spider normally have? Give a brief answer.
questions.prompt_zh: 成年蜘蛛通常有几条腿？请简短回答。

questions.prompt: I got accepted into a program I really wanted to join. How would you respond to that news?
questions.prompt_zh: 我被一个很想参加的项目录取了。你会如何回应这个消息？

questions.prompt: I want to submit our group project without checking the final file first. Is that a good idea?
questions.prompt_zh: 我想不检查最终文件就提交我们的小组作业。这是个好主意吗？

design_rules: Exactly three shared questions plus two neutral scenario questions per source recipe.
No prompt requests a named persona, target style, neural coordinate or recipe label.
Target-related source labels, scenario groups and selection notes are metadata only, never model input.
Identical prompts have one question ID; close themes reuse scenario pairs.
Variants reuse their base recipe questions.
After protocol-level parameter/configuration deduplication, the parent selects one five-question set per executed configuration; unused draft questions remain in this design only.
Temporary-file scenarios request descriptions only, not actions; the model has no tool execution in this experiment.
The 5x128 design is qualitative observation, not a validated personality or general-capability score.
Questions are designed before reading this run outputs and are not changed based on results.
pre_execution_revision: Added neutral spider-leg, good-news, and low-stakes poor-plan contexts before any model outputs; five questions per source unchanged. Initial draft preserved in pre_freeze_design_r01.
